title: Refine Emberstone Studio footer styling in settings
summary:
Given the summary is being requested to compact this long conversation, let me provide the concise 150-word summary.

Session covered: (1) Confirmed all Tasker board tasks done; created task `owner-only-chrome-web-store-release-follow-ups-8398` for manual Chrome Web Store publishing steps. (2) Diagnosed and fixed a CI failure in `settingsPrivacyDisclosure.test.mjs` (copy mismatch "Refresh all thumbnails" vs "Thumbnails"), committed as `ee61850`, verified CI green. (3) Discussed monetization strategy — settled on donationware model with Emberstone Studio branding (site: emberstone-studio.com, Ko-fi: ko-fi.com/emberstonestudio). Iteratively refined a Settings-panel footer (task `add-developed-by-emberstone-studio-footer-to-set-b708`): from full "Developed by" banner → two side-by-side icon+label buttons ("See more from Emberstone Studio", "Buy us a coffee") matching Theme/Search-engine card style, sharing `--bg` and transparent borders via shared `.settings-action-btn`/`.settings-theme-btn` idiom. (4) Reverted a broken custom slider-track CSS attempt back to native rendering. (5) Unified search-popup/bookmarks max-height to 850px to fit 20 history items plus new shared `.search-panel-header` with an "Open history page" button styled like `.bookmarks-tab`. All changes committed and pushed as `d1ace2d`; only pre-existing unrelated test failure (`asyncLatestWins.test.mjs`) remains.
